title: New Jersey is a fossil hotspot, with answers about the day the dinosaurs died
summary: Paleontologist Ken Lacovara never expected to find critical fossil data in a New Jersey suburb—let alone info about the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs. His dig site is now a fossil park and museum.
contentText:
Paleontologist Ken Lacovara never expected to find critical fossil data in a New Jersey suburb—let alone info about the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs. His dig site is now a fossil park and museum.

(Image credit: Edelman Fossil Park & Museum of Rowan University )
